surface_verification.justification: Pure Python config-reader migration in shared/scripts/{lib,tools,hooks}; no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own -- verification is the full shared/tests unit/integration suite (F0), including new round-trip tests writing real on-disk phase_tasks[] fixtures and reading them back through each of the 4 migrated readers.

behaviors.behavior: state.py::detect_current_phase reads phase_tasks[] as primary, not current_step/completed_steps, even when they disagree
state.py: all phase_tasks[] phases done -> complete, even though current_step/completed_steps still claim partial progress
state.py: a v1-only (no phase_tasks[]) run whose completed_steps covers the whole pipeline still reads complete (code-review regression fix)
state.py: a backlog-only (queued, not yet claimed) phase_tasks[] entry counts as current, not a fallback trigger
update_build_dashboard.py: Build Summary/Test Results sections key on phase_tasks[] only, ignoring stale completed_steps
update_build_dashboard.py: pipeline status strip ignores stale completed_steps/current_step and falls through cleanly when phase_tasks[] gives no confident signal
generate_handoff_on_stop.py: _detect_phase_complete's inputs derive from phase_tasks[] primary, v1 fields fallback only when phase_tasks[] gives no signal
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_generate_handoff_on_stop.py::TestPhaseTasksProgress (6 tests, incl. stale-field-ignored and backlog-as-current) PASSED

behaviors.behavior: suggest_iterate.py: handle_in_progress_pipeline reads phase_tasks[] primary; reaches the post-test classify_for_iterate branch when phase_tasks[] says test is done (hard assertion, not soft subprocess stdout check)
malformed phase_tasks[] status (non-string) does not crash any of the 4 readers and is treated as current, not silently absent
behaviors.evidence: test_malformed_status_does_not_crash across shared/tests/test_state.py, test_generate_handoff_on_stop.py, test_suggest_iterate.py, and shared/scripts/tests/test_build_dashboard.py::test_pipeline_status_malformed_task_status_does_not_crash -- all PASSED

behaviors.behavior: the unrelated build-step-number current_step:int|None local in update_build_dashboard.py's format_status/STEP_LABELS is untouched by this migration
behaviors.evidence: shared/scripts/tests/test_build_dashboard.py existing format_status tests still PASSED unchanged; confirmed via self-review grep of the diff

behaviors.behavior: a full driven-run integration flow (project->design->plan->build) still resolves the correct current phase via get_checkpoint/detect_current_phase once current_step stopped being consulted
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_integration.py::test_full_workflow PASSED (fixture updated with a phase_tasks[] block after this was the one genuine regression the migration surfaced)

behaviors.behavior: state-recovery and single-session pipeline flows are unaffected by the migration at the integration-tests root
behaviors.evidence: integration-tests/test_state_recovery.py (11 tests), test_single_session_pipeline.py (3 tests), test_single_session_capstone.py (3 tests) all PASSED
